mechanism: Eslicarbazepine is a CYP3A4 inducer that may increase methotrexate metabolism and clearance, potentially reducing methotrexate efficacy; additionally, both drugs can cause hepatotoxicity and myelosuppression with additive bone marrow effects.
action: Monitor methotrexate efficacy and CBC counts closely; consider methotrexate dose adjustment if needed; assess liver function tests periodically due to overlapping hepatotoxicity risk.
